summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed an 8-K with items 8.01 and 9.01 on May 12, 2026, attaching two press releases. The first, dated May 7, 2026, provides a business update on progress in offshore charging and autonomous operations for maritime drones, including successful autonomous docking and charging demonstrations. The second, dated May 12, 2026, announces the deployment of three PowerBuoy systems supporting a U.S. Department of Homeland Security maritime surveillance operation. The filing is a routine business update, not a special situation, as it simply announces operational progress and a government contract deployment.
